purpose: Single source of truth for EHR evidence app destinations. Everything lives under G:\Industry Dataset: the private workspace root is authoritative for protected data, outputs, logs and verification; approved runtime/cache categories use the separate runtime root. Edit this file to move destinations inside those roots; the setup script and the verifier both read it.

policy.preflight: Every configured directory and file path is resolved against its fixed root and checked before any directory is created. Existing ancestors are inspected without following links.
policy.runtime_root_policy: Only directory keys fixed in the storage policy module (RUNTIME_DIRECTORY_KEYS) may set "root": "runtime"; their paths are relative to runtime_root. Every other key, including protected data, outputs, logs, verification and ClearML configuration, stays relative to workspace_root. Any other destination is refused.

runtime_root.purpose: Runtime root for approved runtime/cache categories. Created once, with restrictive ACLs, by the runtime storage preflight (--create-root).

prepared_data.purpose: Application prepared evidence derived from source data.

outputs.purpose: Generated responses, evaluation and audit artefacts.

test_scratch.purpose: Scratch for synthetic tests that exercise workspace-only destination rules. Tests create and remove only their own subdirectories; pytest's own basetemp is on the runtime root.

pytest_temp.purpose: pytest basetemp. Contents are removed by each pytest run.

pytest_cache.purpose: pytest cache_dir, kept out of the source tree.

xdg_cache.purpose: XDG_CACHE_HOME for tools that follow the XDG layout.

conda_pkgs.purpose: conda package cache for downstream environments.

conda_envs.purpose: Location for new downstream conda environments.

uv_project_env.purpose: UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT target. Not pre-created so uv can create the virtual environment itself.

venvs.purpose: Convention location for manually created virtual environments. No environment variable; use an explicit path when creating one.

clearml_local.purpose: Local ClearML storage and the ClearML configuration-file destination.

clearml_cache.purpose: ClearML cache directory (CLEARML_CACHE_DIR). ClearML documents offline session data beneath its cache directory; that behaviour is not exercised here.

environment.name: EHR_WORKSPACE_ROOT
environment.purpose: Authoritative workspace root for protected data, outputs, logs and verification records.

environment.name: EHR_RUNTIME_ROOT
environment.purpose: Runtime root for environments, temp and caches.

environment.name: TMPDIR
environment.purpose: POSIX-style temporary directory honoured by Python tempfile.

environment.name: PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX
environment.purpose: Keeps .pyc files out of the source tree. Must be set before the interpreter starts.

environment.name: UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT
environment.purpose: Target virtual environment for uv in this project.

environment.name: CONDA_ENVS_DIRS
environment.purpose: conda environment location for new downstream environments.

environment.name: PYTEST_ADDOPTS
environment.purpose: Routes pytest temporary directories and cache to the runtime root without requiring pytest to be installed. Forward slashes avoid shlex escaping issues in paths containing spaces.

environment.name: CLEARML_CACHE_DIR
environment.purpose: ClearML cache and local offline storage root.

environment.name: CLEARML_CONFIG_FILE
environment.purpose: ClearML configuration-file destination. The file is deliberately not created here; writing an unvalidated configuration would risk an invalid format.

environment.name: CLEARML_OFFLINE_MODE
environment.purpose: Keeps ClearML offline by default; hosted runs opt in explicitly.

source_service_exception.location: Existing installation and database-managed storage on C:
source_service_exception.access: Read-only source access to the existing local database.
source_service_exception.notes: Destination setup does not read, connect to, move or reconfigure the service or its data directory.

locations_outside_this_configuration.note: Locations this configuration does not route. Categories: approved-exception (permitted by the data-handling policy), pre-existing (already present and observed, untouched here), unverified-possible-write (a tool may write there; not observed or confirmed).

entries.detail: Read-only source-service exception. Not read, connected to or reconfigured by destination setup.

entries.item: Python interpreter and Anaconda base installation
entries.detail: Running an existing installed interpreter from C: is permitted. CONDA_PKGS_DIRS and CONDA_ENVS_DIRS are configured for new packages and environments; the base installation stays in place.

entries.item: conda user configuration and environment state
entries.detail: conda was not run, so its actual write locations are unverified. conda does support redirection of its configuration file through CONDARC, and further directories can be set within that file; neither was configured or exercised here.

entries.item: PowerShell profile and Windows shell state
entries.detail: Tool-managed. Not configured, observed or measured.
